import json
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.run_pickcube_repeat import plan
from scripts.run_u1_repeat import plan as u1_plan
for seed in [1,2]:
 assert plan(seed)==json.loads(Path(f'artifacts/repeat-plan-check-001/seed{seed}.json').read_text())
for seed in [0,1,2]:
 jobs=u1_plan(seed);assert len(jobs)==5
 bc='e1-bc-full-003' if seed==0 else f'pick-seed{seed}-bc-001'
 for job in jobs:
  c=job['command'];assert c[c.index('--seed')+1]==str(seed)
  if c[1]=='scripts/train_sac.py':
   assert '--critic-layer-norm' in c
   assert c[c.index('--bc-checkpoint')+1]==f'checkpoints/{bc}/final.pt'
  if '--resume-checkpoint' in c:assert c[c.index('--resume-checkpoint')+1]==f'checkpoints/u1-pick-seed{seed}-c-001/final.pt'
  assert not any('checkpoints/e3-' in x for x in c)
 Path(f'artifacts/u1-and-task-plan-check-001/u1-seed{seed}.json').write_text(json.dumps(jobs,indent=2))
for task,tag,horizon,control in [('StackCube-v1','stack',300,'pd_ee_delta_pos'),('PegInsertionSide-v1','peg',400,'pd_ee_delta_pose')]:
 jobs=plan(0,task);assert len(jobs)==8
 for job in jobs:
  c=job['command'];assert job['id'].startswith(tag+'-seed0-')
  if '--env-id' in c:assert c[c.index('--env-id')+1]==task
  for flag in ['--max-episode-steps','--num-eval-steps']:
   if flag in c:assert c[c.index(flag)+1]==str(horizon)
  if '--control-mode' in c:assert c[c.index('--control-mode')+1]==control
  assert not any('PickCube' in x or 'pickcube' in x or 'checkpoints/e' in x for x in c)
 Path(f'artifacts/u1-and-task-plan-check-001/{tag}-seed0.json').write_text(json.dumps(jobs,indent=2))
Path('artifacts/u1-and-task-plan-check-001/result.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(valid=True,original_pick_plans_unchanged=True,u1_matched_bc_and_normalized_parent=True,new_task_protocols_checked=True,new_environment_interactions=0),indent=2))
